messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Rhipe with arules
parts:
certainly. Depending on your installation

a) install it on all the nodes
b) install it on your client node, package up R and ship it to nodes during job run time

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/wiki/Using-rhipe-on-a-cluster--without--installing-R-on-the-nodes

If you copy paste code, copy from the raw file - github ruins the code because of some bad org-mode parsing issues.

Saptarshi
